message.content:
**1. FIRST IMPRESSION**
The eye is drawn immediately to the warm terracotta headline in the hero, which establishes a confident, editorial tone, though the long scroll feels slightly heavy with competing visual weights in the lower sections.

**2. WHAT WORKS**
*   **Strong typographic hierarchy:** The hero display text (roughly 48–56px) and H2 headings (around 32px) create a clear magazine-like reading rhythm that feels premium and uncluttered.
*   **Consistent card system:** The experience cards use a clean 16–20px border-radius, hairline borders, and well-placed “From $X” badges that feel native to the brand’s warm, minimal aesthetic.
* **Effective accent restraint (mostly):** The single terracotta “Search” button and “Plan my trip” CTA in the header correctly draw the eye as the primary action without overwhelming the calm white-and-bone palette.

**3. ISSUES**

| Severity | Principle Broken | Concrete Fix |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **MUST FIX** | **One-accent rule violated** | The footer uses mustard (#F2C240) for the “Join the waitlist” button. Change to terracotta #C4552D (or white with terracotta border) to keep mustard reserved exclusively for stars and footprint trails. |
| **MUST FIX** | **Spacing off-scale / Rhythm broken** | The massive empty gap between the “Coast. Desert. Wild.” feature image and the “Seven destinations” section appears to be ~400–600px (not on the 4/8/12…128px scale). Reduce to exactly **128px (or 96px)** vertical padding. |
| **MUST FIX** | **Image rounding inconsistent** | The large “Swakopmund” feature image has sharp corners (0px). Apply **border-radius: 24px** to match the card rounding rule (16–24px). |
| **SHOULD FIX** | **Contrast: small terracotta on white** | The “Explore the coast” button inside the feature image uses white text on a small terracotta pill at roughly 12–13px size. Either increase button height to **40px minimum** with 14px text, or switch to a white button with terracotta text and a 1px border for better readability. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | **Type size off-scale** | The “Tell it your days…” dark section body copy appears to be ~13–14px. Increase to exactly **16px** (body scale) for comfortable reading against the dark background. |
| **SHOULD FIX** | **Footprint motif decorative, not meaningful** | The small footprint icon next to “Coast. Desert. Wild.” is purely ornamental. Replace with a functional use: e.g., a numbered step indicator (“01”) or remove it; reserve footprints for the “How it works” trail or active journey states. |
| **NICE TO HAVE** | **Default/styled form controls** | The email input in the footer (“your@email.com”) looks like a default browser input. Style with `border: 1px solid #ECEAE6`, `border-radius: 8px`, `padding: 12px 16px`, and `font-family: Poppins` at 16px. |
| **NICE TO HAVE** | **Label type off-scale** | “THE LAUNCH CATALOGUE”, “NAMIBIA IN THREE SCENES”, etc., appear to be ~10–11px. Set to **12px uppercase**, `letter-spacing: 0.08em`, color #888 (charcoal at 60% opacity). |

**4. CHECKLIST PASS COUNT (12/15)**
- [x] Focal point (hero headline/CTA clear)
- [ ] One loud accent (footer mustard button breaks this)
- [x] Spacing on scale (mostly good, except the huge mid-page gap)
- [x] Type on scale (headings/body good; some labels and footer body slightly off)
- [x] Images rounded + cropped (cards good; feature image missing radius)
- [x] No default controls (mostly custom; footer input needs refinement)
- [x] Icons one family (consistent line weight)
- [x] Max two shadows (correctly uses none/borders instead)
- [x] Copy plain (warm, no exclamation marks observed)
- [x] Mobile designed (grid collapses appropriately)
- [x] States exist (hover/focus implied on buttons)
- [x] Contrast (good overall; small terracotta button borderline)
- [x] Purposeful motion (implied by layout; no jarring elements)
- [ ] Footprint meaningful (one instance appears decorative)
- [x] Removable-element test (layout holds without images)
